### Headline summary
- Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in an $115 billion all-stock deal to bolster AI connectivity infrastructure. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/marvell-agrees-to-acquire-lumentum-in-all-stock-ai-connectivity-deal/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-03/nvidia-s-huang-gave-blessing-to-marvell-lumentum-megadeal))
- Salesforce announced a definitive agreement to acquire customer service automation startup Cresta for approximately $2.7 billion. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/exclusive-salesforce-acquires-startup-cresta-2-7-billion), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261102/p48#a261102p48))
- Anthropic filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq, marking a significant step in its corporate development. ([gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/03/anthropics-revised-ipo-filing-reports-33-2-billion-in-nine-month-revenue-and-895-billion-in-compute-commitments/), [The Marketing AI Show](https://podcast.smarterx.ai/))

### Marvell to acquire Lumentum in $115 billion deal
Marvell Technology agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock transaction valued at $115 billion, a move supported by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to bolster AI connectivity infrastructure. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/marvell-agrees-to-acquire-lumentum-in-all-stock-ai-connectivity-deal/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-03/nvidia-s-huang-gave-blessing-to-marvell-lumentum-megadeal), [EE Times](https://www.eetimes.com/marvell-snaps-photonics-chipmaker-lumentum-to-bolster-ai-connectivity/), [The Stack](https://www.thestack.technology/marvells-history-making-deal-for-lumentum-will-test-the-staying-power-of-the-ai-data-center-boom/))

### Salesforce to acquire Cresta for $2.7 billion
Salesforce announced a definitive agreement to acquire customer service automation startup Cresta for approximately $2.7 billion, adding voice-led AI capabilities to its portfolio. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/exclusive-salesforce-acquires-startup-cresta-2-7-billion), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261102/p48#a261102p48), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/salesforce-agrees-to-buy-cresta-for-voice-led-customer-service-ai/), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/salesforce-acquire-cresta-deal-reportedly-valued-ai-digital-support))

### Anthropic files for Nasdaq IPO
Anthropic has filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq, a development highlighted in recent news coverage and newsletters. ([gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/03/anthropics-revised-ipo-filing-reports-33-2-billion-in-nine-month-revenue-and-895-billion-in-compute-commitments/), [The Marketing AI Show](https://podcast.smarterx.ai/), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114428-anthropic-ipo-filing-reveals-17-billion-quarterly-personnel.html), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/press-release/20261103/startrader-spotlights-anthusd-pre-ipo-cfd-as-anthropic-files-to-list-on-nasdaq))

### Google ties school Search access to AI usage
Google announced that schools which choose to disable its AI tools for students will lose access to Google Search, linking the two services in its education platform. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261103/p18#a261103p18), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/future-society/google-search-engine-access-schools-ban-ai), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/03/google-will-let-schools-disable-its-ai-tools-but-not-without-sacrificing-search/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2305432/google-says-that-students-in-schools-that-ban-ai-wont-have-access-to-search/))

### OpenAI hires former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll
OpenAI appointed former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as a senior counselor to oversee national security modernization and expand the company's role in military AI applications. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/openai-hires-ex-army-secretary-senior-advisor), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.ft.com/content/e6b8fd40-ef92-46e8-aeaf-f98dade55a67), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/former-army-secretary-dan-driscoll-joins-openai-as-senior-counselor/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-openai-hires-army-secretary-national.html))

### Binance details $6.3 billion hack plot
Binance revealed that hackers plotted a $6.3 billion heist over several months, using fake job interviews and a compromised internal AI tool to gain control of engineering machines. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/03/technology/binance-report.html), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/binance-details-fake-job-interviews-and-ai-tool-compromise-in-hack/), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/03/technology/binance-hack-report.html), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/binance-says-hackers-used-bogus-job-interview-ai-tool))

### Nvidia instructs cloud clients to reduce China exposure
Nvidia has verbally instructed its cloud computing clients to limit their business with Chinese companies, imposing new restrictions on China's access to AI chips. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-03/nvidia-tells-data-center-clients-to-trim-china-business-ft-says), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261103/p1#a261103p1), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/nvidia-tells-cloud-clients-take-less-china-business), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/nvidia-pushes-cloud-customers-to-cut-back-on-china-business/))

### Fal raises $1.3 billion Series F at $16B valuation
AI inference startup Fal announced a $1.3 billion Series F funding round led by Bessemer, valuing the company at $16 billion as it expands its inference capacity. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261103/p24#a261103p24), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/fal-announces-series-f-led-by-bessemer-to-expand-ai-inference-capacity/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/03/ai-inference-startup-fal-doubles-its-valuation-to-16b-as-demand-surges/))
